handleGithubWebhook.title: Handle GitHub Webhook
handleGithubWebhook.description: Handles the webhook event from Github when a PR is approved and sends a notification to Slack
handleGithubWebhook.setupInstructions:
To set up this webhook in GitHub:

1. Go to your GitHub repository
2. Click on "Settings" > "Webhooks" > "Add webhook"
3. Set the Payload URL to your deployed function's URL (e.g., https://your-api-gateway-url/prod/github-webhook)
4. Set the Content type to "application/json"
5. Select "Let me select individual events"
6. Check "Pull request reviews"
7. Ensure "Active" is checked
8. Click "Add webhook"

Make sure to set the following environment variables:
- GITHUB_TOKEN: Your GitHub personal access token
- SLACK_BOT_TOKEN: Your Slack bot token
- SLACK_CHANNEL_ID: The ID of the Slack channel to send notifications to

Note: Ensure your Slack bot has the necessary permissions to post messages in the specified channel.
